vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: MikroTik RouterOS Improper Neutralization of Argument Delimiters in a Command Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: MikroTik RouterOS contains an improper neutralization of argument delimiters in a command vulnerability which allows an attacked to change the trusted RouterOS policy mask, leading to privilege escalation.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: MikroTik RouterOS Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: MikroTik RouterOS contains a missing authenticaion for critical function vulnerability which allows kernel memory disclosure and denial of service in the btest service.
